1513.overview:
Enter the world of Viewpoint, this stunning 3D diagonal-scrolling shooter, a visual masterpiece which allows you to play from a three-quarter perspective. Unimaginable enemies and inventive traps lurk around every corner and the intense action will rattle your senses! Enough gameplay to please even the most advanced gamer.
Begin the fight with the rapid-fire gun and along the way collect the three shot device of destruction. Also, store energy to use The Wave in 4 levels of power. Or, choose from one of three different bombs to shoot your way through 6 stages of the most spectacular warzones of all time!

1514.overview: The main gameplay aspect is a 2D fighting game in which SNK is mostly know for. The player can choose from 10 different characters each with their own unique moves and abilities. One feature that this game has over other games in the genre is the ability to add a defeated foes special abilities to their own repertoire, however they can only do one move at a time and if they choose to change a move, the previous one is lost for the rest of the game. Additionally, when the player defeats their mirror image their move will be amplified. The player will face each opponent twice in a tournament style before reach the final boss at the end of the game.

479074.overview:
Violent Vengeance: the Universe Hero is a one-on-one fighting game developed by Accend on MS-DOS in 1995.

We are bringing it to the Neo Geo with a brand new game engine, entirely revised gameplay, and some extra goofiness.

It features:

10 playable characters (and their associated stages), each with the special moves you’ve come to expect 
2 bosses (not playable)
